liam-cust: Hey support — our Apr invoice for acct 98765 shows ~3.2M embedding units billed but the dashboard for the same period only shows ~800k. Can you help reconcile? Suspect rerank/batch requests or retries causing double billing. Posting a small repro and logs below.

liam-cust: curl example we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-1024","inputs":["long text...", "short text"],"batch_id":"b-87c"}'
```

liam-cust: And a rerank call we send right after (pairwise mode):
```json
{"model":"rerank-x","pairwise":true,"queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[["a","b"],["c","d"]],"request_id":"req-452"}
```

maya-support: Thanks Liam — can you paste the raw request_id(s) from the logs + one invoice id? Also did you observe any 5xxs or retries in the app logs?

liam-cust: invoice id INV-2026-04-03-98765. Logs show a few 502s from the edge for that hour and our client library retries once automatically (no idempotency key set). Example entry: `2026-04-03T14:12:07Z request=req-452 status=502` then retry `request=req-452 status=200`.

deploy-bot: [deploy] gateway v2.14 rolled out 2026-04-03T13:55:02Z — noted transient 502 spike at 14:11Z related to peering flaps (auto-mitigation kicked).

sam-mleng: Quick thought — rerank in pairwise mode should be billed per pair. If the dashboard aggregates per incoming rerank request (not per pair) we could see a mismatch vs invoice which uses billing units per pair. Can you confirm the rerank billing metric used here?

liam-cust: Yeah, dashboard shows ~12k rerank calls in that window; invoice shows 48k units, which would match ~4 pairs per call. Our payloads do vary; some calls are pairwise, some are single-pass.

maya-support: Initial triage summary: two separate contributors likely combined to cause the delta — (1) client retries were retried without idempotency keys so metering treated them as separate billable requests, and (2) rerank billing is emitted as \"pairs_processed\" from the runtime, but the product dashboard was incorrectly summing \"requests_received\" for the rerank tile. Additionally we spotted an edge case: some embedding requests in the logs were served by a fallback variant (embed-small-128) due to model alias resolution when capacity constrained; the metering service has a model-family->unit-price mapping bug and billed those fallbacks at the higher per-dim price.

alex-finance: Please confirm invoice window (Apr 03 00:00-23:59 UTC) and whether we should provisionally credit duplicates while engineering investigates.

maya-support: Invoice window confirmed. Proposed immediate actions: 1) Issue provisional credit for duplicate retries (estimate based on request_id dedupe heuristic) 2) Fix dashboard aggregation to use pairs_processed for rerank tile 3) Patch metering mapping for alias->variant pricing 4) Prevent client-side silent retry from dropping idempotency header in our SDK notes.

sam-mleng: Repro steps for eng (I ran a local repro):
```bash
# create a rerank pairwise payload (no idempotency-key header)
for i in {1..3}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
    -d '{"model":"rerank-x","pairwise":true,"queries":["q"],"candidates":[["a","b"],["c","d"]],"request_id":"repro-1"}' &
done
# result: backend emits 12 pairs_processed units; retries without idempotency counted again
```

sam-mleng: Also tested embedding fallback: when embed-1024 capacity exhausted, requests routed to embed-small-128 alias; metering service used wrong mapping and applied embed-1024 price tier. Patch in metering mapping PR ready at eng-infra repo.

liam-cust: Appreciate the quick look. Can you also reconcile which specific requests got double billed so we can confirm the credit? We have internal logs for request ids.

maya-support: Action items + owners: 
- maya-support -> create billing support ticket and provisional credit INV-2026-04-03-98765 (refs: TKT-5642)
- sam-mleng -> land metering mapping patch + add unit tests (refs: PR-873)
- eng-sre (cc @deploy-bot) -> add short-term server-side dedupe for identical request hash for 30s window to avoid accidental double billing from transient retries
- devex -> update SDK to warn when retrying without idempotency-key (docs task)

maya-support: Liam, can you DM your app logs for the top 20 request_ids from 14:10-14:20 UTC? We'll reconcile exact credits. Thanks :pray:

liam-cust: Sent. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: [ticket created] TKT-5642 created, assigned to billing-team.

maya-support: Closing thread here — keeping the ticket open for final reconciliation. Will post final credit amount once billing confirms. :white_check_mark:
